text.p: Aspect Telecommunications Corp, which sells call center software and services, said it has acquired Prospect Software Inc in a stock swap deal worth about $7.6 million.
Privately held Prospect supplies software for integrating telephones and computers.

Under the terms of the acquisition agreement, Aspect has exchanged 140,000 shares of Aspect common stock for all of the outstanding shares of Prospect capital stock, Aspect said. It said the value of the transaction is about $7.6 million based on the closing price of Aspect shares today, October 21.
Apect said it expects the transaction to be accounted for as a pooling of interests.

San Jose-based Aspect Telecommunications provides business solutions for mission-critical call centers. Aspect products include automatic call distributors, interactive response systems, management information and reporting tools and planning and forecasting packages. Aspect also provides consulting, systems integration and training.
Prospect sells application development tools for building software connectivity for automatic call distribution call center systems and computer networks. It is based in San Jose.
